findings.title: [P2] Preserve the existing empty-name result
findings.body: For valid inputs such as `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the previous nullish fallback returned the trimmed empty string. The new truthiness fallback returns `"Anonymous"`, changing the exported function’s observable behavior despite the stated goal of preserving existing contracts.

findings.title: [P2] Preserve the existing empty-name result
findings.body:
For allowed inputs such as `{ name: "" }` or `{ name: "   " }`, the previous implementation returned the trimmed empty string, while `name || "Anonymous"` now returns `"Anonymous"`. This breaks the exported function’s existing observable contract for callers that use an empty name to suppress display text.

_Recommend validating this comment independently._
